basic_info.description: Located between Lake St. and California St. in one of San Francisco’s most sought-after neighborhoods, this light-filled second-story condo blends charm, comfort, and convenience. Inside, you’ll find a large primary bedroom with an oversized nook perfect for a walk-in closet, home office, or reading retreat. The expansive living room features large windows that pour in natural light and a cozy fireplace for cool San Francisco evenings. The home also offers 1.5 bathrooms, a dedicated laundry room, and a one-car garage plus a generous storage unit and shared backyard. Just one block from the Presidio, you’ll have endless trails, parks, and outdoor activities at your doorstep all while being close to Golden Gate Bridge, The Marina, Mountain Lake park, shops, cafes, and public transit.
